suggested_requirements.text: The Detention Facility Officer shall capture defendant, incident, and financial information.
The Detention Facility Officer shall schedule an Indigency Hearing.
The Magistrate shall determine if a defendant is indigent.
The Magistrate shall submit a Request for Appointed Counsel to the Office of Attorney Appointments.
The Office of Attorney Appointments shall select a Defense Attorney from the appointment rotation list.
The Office of Attorney Appointments shall notify the defendant, defense attorney, and detention facility officer of an appointment.
The Defense Attorney shall record the date and type of first contact with the defendant.
The Court Coordinator shall enter setting information into the Court Case Management System.
The Auditor shall remit payment to the Defense Attorney upon approval by the Commissioners Court.
The Office of Attorney Appointments shall generate reports for the Task Force on Indigent Defense.
Law enforcement agencies must capture defendant and incident information within 48 hours of arrest.
Magistrates must submit requests for counsel within 24 hours of the indigency hearing.
The Office of Attorney Appointments must process requests for counsel no later than the end of the first working day after receipt.
The system must notify law enforcement agencies of denied requests within 24 hours.
The system must notify the appointed attorney and defendant of an appointment within 24 hours.
The Defense Attorney must capture the date and type of first contact no later than the end of the first working day after the appointment.
The system must comply with the Texas Code of Criminal Procedure.
The system must comply with the Texas Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (UETA).
The system must comply with the Texas Department of Information Resources guidelines for electronic transactions and signed records.
The system must integrate with the Court Case Management System.
The system must integrate with the District Attorney Electronic Case Filing System.
The system must integrate with external accounting systems.
The system must use the Global Justice XML Data Model (GJXDM).
